rules.amplitudes: per-exposure SNR * sqrt(pinv(plane-only unpadded weighted design normal matrix)[0,0]); computed at true position
rules.noise: same seed, full native array shapes and frame ordering as paired Gaussian cache; one noise stream shared by conditions
rules.weight: original inverse variance, fixed; no IRLS and no chi-square inflation
rules.truth_point: known injection location, per epoch; no optimizer or point-estimator/coverage claim
rules.qualification: three already opened fields; synthetic noise, fixed nuisance positions, no source shot noise or physical PSF validation

limitations: No centroid fit or coverage evaluation
Per-exposure derivative matrices are a post-run deterministic reconstruction from cached native inputs using the same frozen implementation; raw report did not record them
same RNG draw index shared between conditions and epochs; 64 draws are not independent fields
old-nearest mean differs from matched-padded; matched theory is not assumed for secondary
